derivation: middle voice of apparently a primary verb;

occurrences.text: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.
Said with a loud voice, Stand upright on thy feet. And he leaped and walked.
